question: In the following question, four letter pairs are given. The letters on left side of (-) is related to the letters on the right side of (-) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three are similar on basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:
